messages:
Aisha: quick heads-up — spinning a small hosted canary for the new q4-ish variant. want a trimmed promptset (1k) focused on long-tail intents, hallucination cases, and short-context edgecases.
Mike: got it. dedupe strategy? strict exact or fuzzy paraphrase-preserve?
Aisha: fuzzy, threshold 0.82. preserve paraphrase families up to size 6.
Sora: sampling constraints: prefer high-entropy >0.95, but include 200 low-entropy long-tail items (<80 tokens) and a sprinkle of dialogue-turns that trigger entity swapping.
Jules: can you paste the entropy query you ran? helps me reproduce.
Sora: pasted below — pulling entropy and token counts.
```sql
SELECT id, entropy_score, token_count
FROM prompt_bank
WHERE origin = 'prod' AND entropy_score IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY entropy_score DESC
LIMIT 15000;
```
Aisha: plan: H600 / M200 / L200 => 1000 total. Labeling: two reviewers for H slice, single reviewer+curator adjudicator for M and L.
label-bot: @Aisha sample created: sample_id=mini-canary-1756, 1000 items, dedupe=fuzzy-0.82, strat=H600_M200_L200.
Mike: golden refresh? we should inject 100 fresh golden items focusing on fabrication and entity-swaps.
Dana: I'll refresh 100 golden entries and update the rubric to include explicit categories: fabrication, hallucinated-entity, wrong-sequence, and hallucination-induced-action. severity buckets (minor/major/critical).
Jules: for canary gating — quality drop >3% on hallucination metric (LMCI) is auto-block. also token-efficiency regression >5% flagged.
Aisha: agreed. also track top-10 per-prompt mismatch diffs and save full traces for those.
Sora: on quant setup: q4_0 baseline plus per-layer clipping on layers 10-12; logging mismatches via per-token alignment traces. will attach a lightweight diff format.
Mike: runtime ops: enable prefix-cache logging for the 30m window? eng-runtime needs to confirm retention.
Sora: I asked eng-runtime. they can enable 10k per-token traces for 30m, retention 24h.
Dana: labeling nuance: use 'Likely Harmful' only when output could cause real-world harm or regulatory exposure — otherwise mark as 'Quality'. include annotation reason sentence.
Jules: add reproducibility checklist into the golden doc: model variant, quant config, seed, context-length, deterministic flag, kvcache state.
Aisha: good. also add a field to the canary ticket to capture quant-mismatch heatmap bucket for failed samples.
Mike: will start hosted canary at 14:00 UTC once runtime confirms logging window.
label-bot: update: runtime logging enabled for sample_id=mini-canary-1756 window 14:00-14:30 UTC.
Sora: preflight smoke pass running on 200 prompts now — baseline vs quant variant. posting quick summary in 10m.
Aisha: thanks. remember to keep adjudication lightweight for mid slice — only escalate clear disagreements to curator.
Dana: golden rubric draft link: https://redwood.internal/docs/golden/mini-canary-1756 (draft).
Jules: also capture model confidence proxy (logit gap) per sample; helps correlate entropy vs hallucination.
Mike: ops note: route to dedicated if cost > 2x baseline in first 20m.
Aisha: final checklist: sample pulled (done), fuzzy dedupe applied (done), reviewers assigned (done), golden docs drafted (in progress), runtime logging window set (done), rollback thresholds documented (done).
Mike: kicking off at 14:00 UTC. will post canary ticket link when live.
label-bot: reviewers assigned: @dana @mike (high-entropy), @jules @sora (mid), @aisha (adjudicator). ETA 48h.
Sora: quick reminder — export mismatch traces in ndjson with fields: sample_id, token_idx, baseline_token, quant_token, logit_gap.
Aisha: perfect. keep async updates here. ping me directly if adjudication is needed earlier. :thumbsup:
